theorem QOU.Archimedean.partialProduct_to_LiTwo_Ioo {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
∃ δ > 0, ∀ (q : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 1 - δ < q ∧ q < 1 ∧ ↑n * (1 - q) > δ⁻¹ → ‖(1 - q) * Real.log (QPochhammer.partialProductLocal q x n) - QPochhammer.LiTwo x‖ < ε

theorem QOU.Archimedean.archimedeanLimit_Ioo {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
QPochhammer.ArchimedeanLimit x

theorem QOU.Archimedean.pow_le_exp_neg_mul {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 < q) (n : ℕ) :
q ^ n ≤ Real.exp (-(↑n * (1 - q)))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.tail_bound {x b : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) :
0 ≤ ∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..b, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ∧ ∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..b, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ≤ b * (x / (1 - x))

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_intervalIntegrable_zero {x b : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hb0 : 0 < b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) :
IntervalIntegrable (fun (u : ℝ) => -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u) MeasureTheory.volume 0 b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_bounds_Ioc {x u : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hu0 : 0 < u) (hu1 : u ≤ 1) :
0 ≤ -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ∧ -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ≤ x / (1 - x)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.riemann_error_bound {x q : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq1 : q < 1) (n : ℕ) :
0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, -Real.log (1 - x * q ^ k) / q ^ k * (q ^ k - q ^ (k + 1)) - ∫ (u : ℝ) in q ^ n..1, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ∧ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, -Real.log (1 - x * q ^ k) / q ^ k * (q ^ k - q ^ (k + 1)) - ∫ (u : ℝ) in q ^ n..1, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ≤ (1 - q) * (-Real.log (1 - x * 1) / 1 - -Real.log (1 - x * q ^ n) / q ^ n)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_integral_ge_left {x a b : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (ha : 0 < a) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (hab : a ≤ b) :
-Real.log (1 - x * a) / a * (b - a) ≤ ∫ (u : ℝ) in a..b, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_integral_le_right {x a b : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (ha : 0 < a) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (hab : a ≤ b) :
∫ (u : ℝ) in a..b, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u ≤ -Real.log (1 - x * b) / b * (b - a)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_intervalIntegrable {x a b : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
IntervalIntegrable (fun (u : ℝ) => -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u) MeasureTheory.volume a b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_continuousOn {x a b : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (ha : 0 < a) :
ContinuousOn (fun (u : ℝ) => -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u) (Set.Icc a b)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.h_monotoneOn {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
MonotoneOn (fun (u : ℝ) => -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u) (Set.Ioc 0 1)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.convexOn_neg_log_one_sub_mul {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc 0 1) fun (u : ℝ) => -Real.log (1 - x * u)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.integral_zero_one_eq_LiTwo {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
∫ (u : ℝ) in 0..1, -Real.log (1 - x * u) / u = QPochhammer.LiTwo x
